description: Add a part and make it the active part before returning. The part starts empty (no seed cube): the first insert_* creates the body. The result partId is a new opaque surf id, not the previously active part. When script is set, that script runs before the call returns (ok, errors, failures, status); a failed script still leaves the part. Agent calls default to the assembly origin; pass position [x,y,z] mm to place it. Working copy only: nothing reaches git without git_save.

position.description: Optional initial translation [x, y, z] mm. Agent create_part defaults to the assembly origin; UI creation still staggers along +X.

name: create_part
